name: Aave Savings GHO
oneLiner: sGHO is Aave's savings wrapper of GHO; deposit GHO to earn the Aave governance-set savings rate in GHO, with GHO-tier CDP risk underneath.
collateral: GHO deposited into Aave's ERC-4626 sGHO savings vault on Ethereum; share value accrues a governance-set fixed APR with no cooldown, no slashing, and no rehypothecation of deposited funds.
pegMechanism: Deposit GHO into the ERC-4626 sGHO vault to mint sGHO shares; the share-to-GHO exchange rate rises as the Aave-governance-set savings rate accrues. The vault's `asset()` is GHO and standard ERC-4626 `convertToAssets()` / `totalAssets()` reads expose NAV per share. Pharos prices this entry from the vault's share exchange rate rather than secondary-market liquidity.
